exposure: infants breastfed after the first hour
infants breastfed within the first hour
outcome: breastfeeding initiation within the first hour
cohort: 400 healthy term babies born in a tertiary care hospital setting
finding: Cesarean delivery and male gender were the strongest risk factors for delayed initiation of breastfeeding, while the use of breast milk substitutes on day one was an independent predictor of failure to continue exclusive breastfeeding at 6 weeks.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was a significant risk factor for delayed initiation of breastfeeding.
